Job Description

Work Arrangement: 

Hybrid: This internship is categorized as on-site. The selected intern is expected to report to the office 3 days a week. 

Location: 

Sunnyvale, CA 

About The Team

The Data Scaling team builds the data, machine learning, and infrastructure foundations that enable Embodied AI models to improve with scale. We work across data collection, curation, mining, labeling, dataset quality, model inputs, distributed training, experiment workflows, and the systems that help researchers and engineers develop, evaluate, and deploy models more efficiently.

Our work supports large-scale autonomous driving models and the broader Embodied AI flywheel. We combine machine learning, data engineering, distributed systems, and software engineering to make high-quality, product-aligned driving data available for perception, planning, trajectory generation, and other autonomy capabilities.

About The Role

As an Embodied AI Data Scaling Intern, you will work on a well-scoped project that improves the scale, quality, efficiency, or reliability of data and model development for autonomous driving. You will collaborate with researchers and engineers to build data pipelines, analyze large datasets, improve training workflows, or develop infrastructure that increases the number and quality of experiments the team can run.

Potential focus areas include:



- Data Curation and Quality: Build methods to select, filter, balance, and validate large driving datasets aligned with product and modeling needs.
- Data Mining and Scenario Discovery: Identify valuable, rare, or challenging driving situations and develop tools to improve coverage of long-tail scenarios.
- Dataset and Labeling Pipelines: Improve automated labeling, data transformation, feature generation, and dataset release workflows.
- Distributed Training and Model Scaling: Optimize the systems, input pipelines, and compute workflows used to train large models on large datasets.
- ML Experimentation and Flywheel Infrastructure: Build tools that help teams develop, train, evaluate, debug, and deploy models more quickly and reliably.


What You’ll Do



- Develop data pipelines and tooling for large-scale, multimodal autonomous driving datasets.
- Analyze data quality, coverage, distribution, and performance impact using quantitative methods.
- Prototype and evaluate approaches for data mining, curation, labeling, sampling, or scenario discovery.
- Improve training throughput, data loading, experiment reproducibility, or resource utilization in distributed computing environments.
- Collaborate with machine learning researchers, data engineers, infrastructure engineers, and autonomy teams.
- Build visualizations, metrics, dashboards, and evaluation workflows to communicate data and model behavior.
- Contribute to production-quality software through design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, continuous integration, and documentation.
- Present technical findings and document experiments, results, and recommendations.


Required Qualifications



- Currently enrolled in or pursuing a Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Demonstrated experience through coursework, research, academic projects, or professional work in machine learning, data engineering, distributed systems, or a related area.
- Strong programming skills in Python.
- Experience working with data processing, databases, machine learning pipelines, or large-scale datasets.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use quantitative analysis to guide decisions.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, team-oriented environment.
- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
- Availability to work full-time, 40 hours per week, during the internship period.


Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, or another machine learning framework.
- Experience with distributed training, parallel computing, high-performance computing, cloud infrastructure, or GPU-based workflows.
- Familiarity with multimodal sensor data, autonomous vehicles, robotics, computer vision, or large-scale time-series data.
- Experience with SQL, data warehouses, workflow orchestration, data quality systems, or distributed data-processing frameworks.
- Familiarity with foundation models, self-supervised learning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or deep learning.
- Experience with C++ or another systems programming language.
- Must be graduating between December 2027 and June 2028
- Intent to return to a degree program after completion of the internship.


Compensation: 



- The monthly salary range for this role is $11,800 – $14,600 per month  
- GM will provide a one-time lump sum taxable stipend payment to eligible students selected for the 2027 Student Program. 


What You’ll Get From Us



- Paid U.S. GM holidays.
- GM Family First Vehicle Discount Program.
- Potential for growth within GM based on performance and business needs.
- Intern events and opportunities to network with company leaders and peers.
- Mentorship and hands-on experience with the data and ML foundations behind autonomy

What Drives Success

As a Cloud Advance Admin/Developer Intern, you will collaborate with developers, administrators, business analysts, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective Salesforce solutions. This is an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in cloud development, application configuration, system integration, automation, and emerging Salesforce technologies.

Successful interns will have the potential opportunity of joining Lennox Full-Time upon graduation. Relocation and/or travel may be required for your position.

Why You’ll #LoveLennox:



-  Impactful Projects: Work on meaningful assignments that drive real business results. Your ideas matter here. 
-  Intern Community: Connect with peers through social events, team-building activities, and engagement programs. 
-  Innovation Exposure: Dive into cutting-edge tech and trends shaping the HVAC and manufacturing industries. 
-  Learning and Development: Access workshops, training sessions, and resources to level up your skills and expand your knowledge. 
-  Competitive Pay and Relocation Support: Receive a competitive compensation package and relocation support if needed. 

 WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:  Salesforce Development & Configuration 



-  Support Salesforce administration, application configuration, and platform maintenance activities. 
-  Develop and enhance solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, and Salesforce APIs. 
-  Assist with configuring objects, fields, workflows, permissions, and other platform capabilities. 
-  Translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions. 

 Testing & Quality Assurance 



-  Perform functional and regression testing to validate Salesforce features and enhancements. 
-  Develop test scenarios and document testing results. 
-  Identify, troubleshoot, and communicate application defects. 
-  Support quality assurance activities throughout the software development lifecycle. 

 Integration & Process Automation 



-  Assist with Salesforce integration analysis and support using REST and SOAP APIs. 
-  Help evaluate data flows and integration points between Salesforce and other enterprise systems. 
-  Support the automation and optimization of existing Salesforce business processes. 
-  Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reliability, and user experience. 

 Documentation & Business Analysis 



-  Document business processes, application configurations, technical designs, and test scenarios. 
-  Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and clarify business needs. 
-  Assist with creating technical documentation and process materials. 
-  Communicate project updates and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

 Innovation & Emerging Technology 



-  Conduct research and proof-of-concept activities involving new Salesforce capabilities. 
-  Explore potential applications of Artificial Intelligence and Salesforce Agentforce. 
-  Support evaluations of emerging platform features and development tools. 
-  Contribute ideas that improve Salesforce functionality and business outcomes. 

 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 



-  Currently pursuing a graduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related technical field 
-  Understanding of object-oriented programming concepts 
-  Knowledge of at least one programming language, preferably Java, JavaScript, Python, C#, or a similar language 
-  Understanding of databases and SQL queries 
-  Familiarity with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript 
-  Understanding of software development lifecycle concepts 
-  Familiarity with version control concepts, preferably Git 
-  Strong analytical, logical, and problem-solving skills 
-  Ability to learn new technologies and concepts quickly 
-  Effective written and verbal communication skills 
-  Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into logical solutions 
-  Self-motivation, curiosity, attention to detail, and willingness to take ownership of assigned work 
-  Ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment 

 Preferred Qualifications 



-  Basic knowledge of the Salesforce platform through coursework, Trailhead learning, certifications, or project experience 
-  Exposure to Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components, or Salesforce Flow 
-  Understanding of REST or SOAP APIs and system integration concepts 
-  Experience with Git, GitHub, or similar version control and collaboration tools 
-  Exposure to Agile methodologies, software testing practices, or application development projects 
-  Interest in Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce 

 WHAT YOU’LL GAIN: 



-  Hands-on experience developing and configuring cloud-based Salesforce solutions 
-  Exposure to Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, APIs, and Salesforce automation tools 
-  Opportunities to collaborate with experienced Salesforce and technology professionals 
-  Experience supporting testing, integrations, documentation, and business process improvements 
-  Insight into Artificial Intelligence, Agentforce, and emerging Salesforce capabilities 
-  Development of cloud development, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills 
-  Practical experience contributing to enterprise technology initiatives within a global organization 

This role offers a unique opportunity to build a foundation in cloud application development while gaining meaningful exposure to the Salesforce ecosystem and contributing to solutions that address real business needs.

What We Are Looking For

Requires a high school diploma or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Entry Level.

Developing professional knowledge in the area of expertise. Solid written and verbal communication skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office.

What We Offer
